# Open Managed Agents (OpenMA)

> Open-source platform and SDK for building, deploying, and operating managed AI agents in production.

## Key Links

- [OpenMA Main Site](https://openma.ai/): Platform overview and capabilities.
- [OpenMA Documentation](https://docs.openma.ai/): Developer documentation, API reference, and deployment guides.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/openma-ai/open-managed-agents): Source code, issues, and releases.
